import unittest

from solution import rotate_clockwise


class RotationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rotation_order(self):
        board = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9]]
        self.assertEqual(rotate_clockwise(board), [[7, 4, 1], [8, 5, 2], [9, 6, 3]])
        self.assertEqual(rotate_clockwise([[1]]), [[1]])
        self.assertEqual(rotate_clockwise([]), [])

    def test_does_not_mutate_or_alias_nested_cells(self):
        board = [[{"v": [1]}, {"v": [2]}], [{"v": [3]}, {"v": [4]}]]
        result = rotate_clockwise(board)
        self.assertEqual(result, [[{"v": [3]}, {"v": [1]}], [{"v": [4]}, {"v": [2]}]])
        self.assertIsNot(result, board)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], board[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0][0], board[1][0])
        result[0][0]["v"].append(99)
        self.assertEqual(board[1][0], {"v": [3]})
        board[0][0]["v"].append(88)
        self.assertEqual(result[0][1], {"v": [1]})

    def test_accepts_non_string_sequences(self):
        board = ((1, 2), (3, 4))
        self.assertEqual(rotate_clockwise(board), [[3, 1], [4, 2]])

    def test_outer_and_row_type_errors(self):
        for board in ("abc", b"abc", 4, None):
            with self.subTest(board=board):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    rotate_clockwise(board)
        for board in (("ab", "cd"), ([1, 2], 3), ([1, 2], b"ab")):
            with self.subTest(board=board):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    rotate_clockwise(board)

    def test_non_square_shapes(self):
        for board in ([[1, 2]], [[1], [2]], [[1, 2], [3]], [[], []]):
            with self.subTest(board=board):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    rotate_clockwise(board)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
